responsibility: Main target header that defines LoongArch machine macros, ABI/layout rules, assembler and linker specs, debugging formats, storage-layout constants, section and symbol conventions, exception-handling register mappings, block-move heuristics, frame-related types, and many other compile-time target properties. It is the macro-level companion to loongarch.cc, exposing the target configuration and target-specific GCC hooks required by the generic compiler headers and build machinery.
same_name_distinction: For the loongarch same-name set, this is the main target header that supplies compile-time machine macros, specs, ABI/layout constants, and shared target declarations consumed by GCC headers and the backend. Unlike loongarch.cc, loongarch.md, and loongarch.opt, it describes target properties through C/C preprocessor interfaces rather than implementing hooks, defining RTL patterns, or declaring command-line options.
